title: An ideal in the Jacobson radical extends into the Jacobson radical of an integral algebra
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a ring map of commutative rings with $B$ integral over $A$, and let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal contained in the Jacobson radical of $A$ (the intersection of the maximal ideals of $A$). Then every maximal ideal $\mathfrak n$ of $B$ has maximal preimage in $A$, hence contains $IB$; consequently $IB$ is contained in the Jacobson radical of $B$, i.e. $1+x$ is a unit of $B$ for every $x\in IB$.
